messages:
sophia: quick heads-up — hitting a weird dim mismatch in the embeddings pipeline when running the Java SDK + pagination. expected 1024, getting 1536 for some pages. repro steps below.

sophia: flow: fetch paginated ids -> batch fetch embeddings via Java client -> concat -> rerank. fails only when page size > 200. smaller pages fine.

sophia: suspecting either a batching helper that doubles vectors or a transpose/reshape bug before quantization.

raj: hmm. any logs? can you paste request payload and response shape?

sophia: logged. response tokens: 
```json
{"embeddings": [{"id":"a","vec_len":1536}, {"id":"b","vec_len":1536}, ...]}
```
request body (Java client snippet):
```java
EmbeddingsRequest req = EmbeddingsRequest.builder()
  .model("open-embed-1024")
  .input(batchInputs)
  .build();
client.embeddings(req);
```

andy: two quick hypotheses:
1) Java SDK is sending batched inputs as a single flattened string which the server interprets as multiple contexts => different model path.
2) Retry middleware in Java replays partial streaming frames, and our server concatenates partial kv caches leading to larger vectors.

maria: also check auth header differences. Go client uses `x-rd-jwt` header in private deploys while Java uses `Authorization: Bearer` by default in some setups — that can route to different tenant config (diff model variant). saw this once with prod vs canary model mapping.

sophia: good call, i'll diff headers.

sophia: quick paste of failing curl (what server actually saw):
```http
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer tok-xyz
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"open-embed-1024","input":["...large batch..."],"pagination":{"page":3,"size":256}}
```

raj: page size 256 -> matches your >200 note. can you run same sequence with Go client and same page size? if Go returns 1024 then it's SDK-side.

sophia: ran Go quickly — returns correct 1024. Java only the problem.

andy: ok then likely Java batching helper: check `BatchUtils.concatVectors` and `reshape` calls — maybe uses row-major vs col-major order when converting float[] -> float[][] causing length mismatch after serialization.

maria: also check grpc vs rest path in Java — if you're using the streaming grpc path inadvertently, the server might be switching to a larger embedding model (we keep 1536 for some legacy models).

sophia: found something: my Java client was configured with `client.setFallbackToStreaming(true)` in our config (leftover from earlier tests). That causes the client to switch to legacy streaming endpoint for large batches.

andy: that explains it — streaming path still uses old embed model (1536). quick fix: disable fallback or explicit model param `open-embed-1024:stable`.

maria: for long-term we should: 1) make SDK warn when fallback triggers for embeddings, 2) add unit test that asserts embedding dim == catalog.dim(model) for every response.

sophia: agreed. will open a PR with tests + config guard. pinging @andy for review once I add the test.

andy: ack. also add an integration case for pagination boundary (size 200/201) so we catch off-by-one triggers.

sophia: adding now. code snippet for the Java guard I'm going to add:
```java
if (response.getEmbeddingDim() != ModelCatalog.dim(request.getModel())) {
  throw new IllegalStateException("embedding-dim-mismatch: " + response.getEmbeddingDim());
}
```

raj: small nit — prefer a validation error log + metric rather than throwing in production path. throw in tests.

sophia: good point. will log + emit metric `embed.dim_mismatch{model=...}` and fail tests.

ci-bot: build triggered for pr/embeddings-dim-guard #432.

maria: thanks. one more ask: can we surface which endpoint was used (rest vs streaming) in client debug logs? makes triage easier.

andy: yes add `client.debug().set("endpoint", response.meta.endpoint)` in SDK. tiny change.

sophia: PR created: https://git.redwood/rd/rd-sdk-java/pull/432 — includes test, metric, and removes fallback default.

andy: reviewing now, will leave inline comments. :thumbsup:

sophia: thanks all. will monitor after merge and revert fallback on the service if needed.

sophia: closing loop: issue was SDK fallback to streaming path + model mismatch routing. root cause tracked and tests added.

dev-bot: noted. incident?no — marked as non-critical.
